SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM TBL_KEP_GR WHERE 1 = 1 AND SYSID = 'PRD' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'SOIL' AS BUYER, PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, UNIT_PRICE, GR_QTY, GR_AMT, GR_DATE, LEGACY_GR_YEAR || '-' || LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, RO_QTY, RO_AMT, REMARK FROM TBL_KEP_GR WHERE 1 = 1 AND SYSID = 'PRD' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
UPDATE TBL_KEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND SYSID = 'PRD' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
